QuestInfo.name: Earth Guardian Pan
QuestInfo.0:
With the #bMemorial Staff#k in your hand, you're not afraid anymore. 

The Earth Guardian looks like he has your back. Will that be enough to make it through the forest?
QuestInfo.1:
After passing the forest's dark edge, it's gradually brightened on the inside. The plants here are beautiful, but you've noticed some are withering. As the Earth Guardian explains it, they're withering because the #rpower of the Forest Master has become stagnant#k. 

For her power to properly circulate, she needs the #bForest Child#k... who just might be you. 
Of course, as the Earth Guardian said, if it's not you, at least you've both made a friend.
QuestInfo.2:
With the help of the #bEarth Guardian#k and your new #bMemorial Staff#k, you entered the forest.
The majestic forest awed you with its grandeur, delighted you with its beauty -- and threatened you with #rmysterious monsters#k. 

In the heat of the fight, you experienced a brief flashback, which revealed the Earth Guardian's name: Pan. 

When you called out his name, he grew to his full size and defended you from the creatures.

0.msg: Hey, Lynn! Like I said, talk to me again when get that lamp from your hut. I'll find a staff.
